title: An Evolutionary Computation Framework for Multi-Agent Q-Learning with Mean-Field Environmental Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2609.13253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning in networked populations is governed by the interaction between individual adaptation, local encounters, and changing environmental conditions. To study this interaction, we formulate a coupled learning--environment model in which agents update stateless $Q$-values on a fixed graph, while their population-average behavior drives an environmental variable that dynamically modifies the payoff matrix. Under a first-order mean-field closure, we derive a deterministic transport equation for the population distribution of $Q$-values and couple it with a projected discrete update for the environmental state. The resulting model is evaluated against finite-network Monte Carlo simulations on random regular, Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi, Barab\'asi--Albert, and random geometric graphs. translated_title: 具有平均场环境反馈的多智能体Q学习演化计算框架
translated_abstract: 网络化种群中的多智能体强化学习受个体适应、局部交互与变化的环境条件之间的相互作用所支配。为了研究这种相互作用，我们构建了一个学习-环境耦合模型，其中智能体在固定图上更新无状态Q值，同时其种群平均行为驱动一个环境变量，该变量动态地修改收益矩阵。在一阶平均场封闭近似下，我们推导出了Q值种群分布的确定性输运方程，并将其与环境状态的投影离散更新相耦合。所得模型在随机正则图、Erdős–Rényi图、Barabási–Albert图和随机几何图上的有限网络蒙特卡洛模拟中进行了评估。在测试的参数范围内，平均场系统重现了主要的宏观合作与环境演化轨迹，并且……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将多智能体Q学习与环境动态反馈相耦合的平均场框架，通过推导Q值分布的确定性输运方程，成功重现了多种网络结构上的宏观合作与环境演化轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mean-field framework coupling multi-agent Q-learning with environmental feedback, deriving a deterministic transport equation for the Q-value distribution that successfully reproduces macroscopic cooperation and environmental evolution trajectories across various network structures.
